title: What part of the chikki is one strip?
description: A whole chikki of 24 squares is split into three equal strips. Counting how many strips fill the whole names one strip as a fraction, and counting squares checks it. Keeko's doubt, that the strip is one eighth because it has eight squares, is broken.
teaching_notes: One idea: a piece is named by how many copies of it fill the whole, not by how many small squares it holds. Watch for students who take the count of squares in the piece as the bottom number.

source: What is the fractional unit of chikki shown below? We get this piece by breaking the chikki into 3 equal pieces. So this is 1/3 chikki.
video_script.why: The child names a piece as a fractional unit by counting how many equal copies of it make the whole, then checks with the small squares.
video_script.substitution: Ask how many strips like this one fill the whole chikki; that count names the unit.
video_script.anchor: A whole chikki of 24 small squares split by two straight cuts into three equal strips, with one strip lit
video_script.wrong_answer: the strip is one eighth because it has eight small squares
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says the strip is one eighth because it has eight small squares. Eight such strips would be far bigger than the chikki; only three fit, so the bubble is struck.
video_script.payoff_line: One strip is one third of the chikki

final_answer.spoken: one strip is one third of the chikki

never_show: 1/8 as the size of the strip
maths_rules: whole chikki: 6 across, 4 down, 6 x 4 = 24 small squares
2 straight up and down cuts split it into 3 equal strips, each 2 across and 4 down
3 equal strips fill the whole, so one strip is 1/3 chikki
check: one strip has 2 x 4 = 8 squares, and 3 x 8 = 24, the whole chikki
slip: 8 squares in the strip does not make it 1/8; 8 strips of 8 squares would need 64 squares, not 24
video_script.design: One idea: count the copies that fill the whole, not the squares in the piece. Assumes the broken chikki question on fourths. Wrong idea: the square count names the fraction. The whole chikki and the lit strip stay on the board to the end.
